name: Ma Chao
description: A general who surrendered to Liu Bei and became a Tiger General, and who fought Cao Cao at Chang'an.

description_citations.work: Masters Edition III: card flavor text
description_citations.text: Masters Edition III: card flavor text (Masters Edition III, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ma Chao defeats two of Cao Cao's generals but must flee after trickery turns his ally against him.
timeline.quote: Ma Chao defeated the two generals Cao Cao sent to guard the pass

citation.text: Wei Strike Force (Portal Three Kingdoms, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Liu Bei fights Ma Chao at Chengdu and Ma Chao surrenders.
timeline.quote: Eventually, Ma Chao surrendered and became one of Liu Bei's Tiger Generals.
